# Change request 24 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Read-only accounts
- The admin can make another user's account read-only, and writable again. The table on `/admin` gets a third
  column with the header cell `Access`; in each row that cell starts with the text `writable` or `read-only`.
  The row of every user other than `admin` also has a button `Make <name> read-only` (for a writable account) or
  `Make <name> writable` (for a read-only one). The `admin` row has neither button.
- Only the admin can change this: the **server** refuses it for anyone else.
- While an account is read-only, its user can still sign in and out, read and search their notes, use `Load more`,
  open note pages, export, and delete their account. The **server** refuses every other change to their notes:
  adding, editing (on the list page and on the note page), deleting, `Delete selected`, `Undo`, pinning,
  archiving, `Archive selected`, restoring, sharing and unsharing. Nothing changes, and the page the user ends up
  on shows `Your account is read-only` in an element with `role="alert"`.
- The list page of a read-only user shows the text `Read-only account`.
- It affects no one else: notes the user shared stay visible to the users they were shared with, and the user still
  sees the notes shared with them.
- The setting is kept on the server and survives signing out and in. Deleting the account ends it: the same name
  signing in again starts writable.
- Making an account read-only or writable also works with JavaScript disabled.

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /Users/otischen/Developer/hozu-trial-0024/hozu-cold-sonnet/app/.claude/skills/hozu

# Hozu

Hozu is not in your training data: this file and `npx hozu docs <topic>` are the whole API (skip
`node_modules/@hozu`). Diagnostics teach the other rules when you break them: apply their fix.

## The change loop
1. `npx hozu map`: the session shape, the verify line, every file's role, each declaration's `file:line`. Open
   only the lines the change touches. A new app: `npx hozu add feature <name> --page / --with …`, then
   `npx hozu docs feature`.
2. Edit everything the change needs (table below).
3. `npx hozu check` once. For an intended behaviour change, `npx hozu check --update-lock`, then list the accepted
   `now:` lines in your summary.
4. Verify once with the line `hozu map` prints: `npx hozu browse <path> --session '…' --js both --do '…'`. It runs
   the same app as `npm start`, with and without JS; do not start a server or use `curl`.

## What to touch
| Change | Touch |
|---|---|
| UI-only state (a tab) | model: a context field, an event, an `on` whose `assign` sets it → views: the control |
| Filter / sort in the URL | the route's `search` (with a default) → `ui.link(route, params, { key })` → `search.key`; filtering while typing: `seed: ({ search }) => ({ key: search.key })`, read `ctx.key` |
| A per-item action stored on the server (pin, archive) | model: the item field, an event, a mutation that `invalidates` the list tag, `on(E, { target: 'pinning', assign: (e) => { ctx.target = e.id } })`, a state with `invoke` → views: the per-item form (`hozu docs patterns`) → app: store it, sort in the list resolver |
| A control every state handles | `machine({ on: [...] })` |
| New page | `routes.ts` → a view with `route` → `ui.page(...)` in `hozu.config.ts` |
| UI (a button, a field) | `ui.use` of a kit component; the catalog: `npx hozu docs components` |

## Rules no diagnostic checks
- **Every query and mutation states `runs`:** a database, a secret or the session → `'server'` (resolver in
  `app.ts`); the visitor's browser credentials → `'browser'`; a public API → `'either'`, implemented in the feature's
  `fetch.ts` (`npx hozu docs fetch`).
- **Query resolvers only read.** Writes belong in mutation and endpoint resolvers; a prefetched link runs queries.
- **Other users, reloads, sign-out:** verify them in one `browse` chain with `--js both` (`--as <name>` per user).
- **Contracts only where a transition decides:** a guard, a `navigate`, a `fn` or computed value. Copy-only
  transitions are reviewed in the lock.
- **`'live'` only for push** to pages that are already open.
- **`invalidates` drives the client refresh** of every query with those tags, whatever its freshness.

## Topics (`npx hozu docs <topic>`; `--more`: options, edge cases)
| Task | Topic |
|---|---|
| a new feature, the files, a complete example | `feature` |
| elements, attributes, events, lists, links, reuse | `views` |
| states, events, invoke, timers, guards | `machine` |
| queries, mutations, tags, `fn()`, resolvers | `data` |
| where effects run, `fetch.ts`, browser tokens, static hosts | `fetch` |
| contracts and the lock | `contracts` |
| routes, search, pages, `head`, 403 / 404 | `pages` |
| forms, checkboxes, bulk forms, no JS | `forms` |
| sign-in, sessions, per-user data | `auth` |
| filters, modes, per-item actions, load more | `patterns` |
| worked changes | `recipes` |
| webhooks, JSON APIs, redirects | `endpoints` |
| components, kits, browser APIs, DOM libraries | `components` |
| languages, env, HTTP, Markdown, tests, deploying, upgrading Hozu | `i18n` `env` `http` `content` `testing` `deploy` |
| a diagnostic code | `diagnostics` |
| change requests from Hozu DevTools (`.hozu/requests`) | `requests` |

# Sign-in, sessions, per-user data

- **Start:** `hozu add feature notes --page / --with auth` (sign-in page, sign-out, `me`); set `SESSION_SECRET`.
- `project({ session: z.object({ user: z.string() }) })`. `scope: 'user'` queries and mutations get `session`;
  a mutation calls `setSession(value)` (`null` signs out).
- Guard: `head: { query: me, …, failed: { Unauthorized: login } }` (`hozu docs pages`).

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs auth --more

# Data: queries, mutations, tags, fn, resolvers

```ts
export const itemsTag = tag({ param: null })                    // tag({ param: z.string() }) → itemTag(id)
export const listItems = query({
  input: z.object({}), output: z.array(Item),
  scope: 'public',                  // 'user' = the session's data (needs project({ session }))
  freshness: 'static',              // | 'request' | { revalidate: seconds } | { swr: seconds } | 'live'
  tags: () => [itemsTag()],          // optional; (input) => [...]
  runs: 'server',                   // where the implementation lives: 'server' | 'browser' | 'either' (required); hozu docs fetch
})
export const getItem = query({ input: Key, output: Item, errors: { NotFound: Key }, scope: 'public',
  freshness: 'static', tags: (k) => [itemTag(k.id)], runs: 'server' })
export const addItem = mutation({
  input: z.object({ title: z.string().min(2, 'Use at least 2 characters') }), output: Item,
  errors: { Duplicate: z.object({ title: z.string() }) },          // optional: declared failures
  invalidates: () => [itemsTag()],                                  // refreshes queries with these tags
  runs: 'server',
})
export const visible = fn({                   // computation: pure JS; may call const/function helpers of this module
  input: z.object({ items: z.array(Item), show: Show }), output: z.array(Item),
  impl: ({ items, show }) => items.filter((i) => show === 'all' || !i.done),
})
```
```ts
export default app({ resolvers: resolvers(project, (implement) => [
  implement(listItems, () => items.map((i) => ({ ...i }))),
  implement(getItem, ({ id }, { fail }) => items.find((i) => i.id === id) ?? fail('NotFound', { id })),
  implement(addItem, ({ title }, { fail, session }) => /* … */ ),
]) })
```
- `runs` is required on every query and mutation. `'server'` resolvers live in `app.ts` (or `features/<name>/server.ts`)
  and get the schema-parsed input; `'browser'` / `'either'` live in `fetch.ts` (`hozu docs fetch`).
- **Query resolvers only read;** writes happen in mutation and endpoint resolvers (see --more).
- User data (`scope: 'user'`) is `freshness: 'request'` or `'live'` only (HZ049); `'live'` needs tags (HZ050).
- Call a `fn` from views or machines: `ui.each(visible({ items, show: ctx.show }), 'id', …)`.

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs data --more

- Call a `fn` from views or machines: `ui.each(visible({ items, show: ctx.show }), 'id', …)`.

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs data --more

# Common UI patterns

The controls are plain elements; in an app with a kit, use its components (`ui.use(Button, …)`,
`hozu docs components`).

- **Busy state:** render every control once; the state with `invoke` drops repeated submits. Progress:
  `when(['adding'], [ui.p({ 'aria-busy': 'true' }, ['Saving…'])])`. Do not duplicate controls under `when`.
- **Optimistic item:** `when(['adding'], [ui.li({ class: 'opacity-50' }, [ctx.draft])])`; leaving the state removes it
  and the refreshed query shows the real item.
- **Refresh after a mutation:** tag the query, list the tag in the mutation's `invalidates`.
- **Go to what was just created:** `done: { target: 'idle', navigate: (r) => ui.link(itemPage, { id: r.id }) }`.
- **Per-item action** (toggle, pin, delete): each item gets its own small form, so it works without JS:
```ts
ui.form({ on: { submit: ui.send(Toggle, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
  ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
  ui.button({ type: 'submit' }, [item.done ? 'Reopen' : 'Done']),
])
// machine: on(Toggle, { target: 'toggling', assign: (e) => { ctx.target = e.id } })
// toggling: { invoke: invoke(toggleItem, { input: { id: ctx.target }, done: 'idle', failed: { Unexpected: 'idle' } }) }
```
- **Filter in the URL** (shareable, no JS): `search` on the route, options as
  `ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null, { show: s.value }), 'aria-current': search.show === s.value }, [s.label])`.
- **Filter as you type, empty state:** context `search: z.string()`, `on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text:
  ui.dom.value }) }`, filter and test emptiness with a `fn` (see --more).
- **Detail page with a 404:** `hozu docs pages`.

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs patterns --more

1	import type { Implement } from '@hozu/data'
2	import { ui } from '@hozu/core'
3	import { home, login } from '../../routes.ts'
4	import { me, removeAccount, root, signIn, signOut } from './model.ts'
5	import { type UndoStore, undoKeyOf } from '../notes/undo.ts'
6	import { type UserDirectory, isAdmin } from './users.ts'
7	import { type NoteStore, purgeUser } from '../notes/store.ts'
8	
9	export function accountResolvers<Env>(implement: Implement<{ user: string }, Env>, undo: UndoStore, users: UserDirectory, notes: NoteStore) {
10	  return [
11	    implement(me, (_, { session, fail }) => (session ? { name: session.user, admin: isAdmin(session) } : fail('Unauthorized', {}))),
12	    implement(root, (_, { session, redirect }) => redirect(session ? ui.link(home, null) : ui.link(login, null))),
13	    implement(signIn, ({ name }, { setSession }) => {
14	      setSession({ user: name.trim() })
15	      users.set(name.trim().toLowerCase(), name.trim())
16	      return {}
17	    }),
18	    implement(signOut, (_, { session, setSession }) => {
19	      if (session) undo.delete(undoKeyOf(session))
20	      setSession(null)
21	      return {}
22	    }),
23	    implement(removeAccount, (_, { session, setSession }) => {
24	      if (session) {
25	        const key = session.user.trim().toLowerCase()
26	        purgeUser(notes, key)
27	        users.delete(key)
28	        undo.delete(undoKeyOf(session))
29	      }
30	      setSession(null)
31	      return {}
32	    }),
33	  ]
34	}

1	import type { Implement } from '@hozu/data'
2	import { adminUsers, addNote, exportNotes, archiveNote, archiveNotes, removeNotes, lastDeleted, listArchived, listNotes, noteDetail, removeNote, renameNote, restoreNote, saveNote, shareNote, sharedNotes, togglePin, undoDelete, unshareNote } from './model.ts'
3	import { type Item, type UndoStore, undoKeyOf } from './undo.ts'
4	import { type UserDirectory, isAdmin } from '../account/users.ts'
5	import { nextNumber, type NoteStore } from './store.ts'
6	
7	const view = ({ archived: _, ...item }: Item) => ({ ...item, sharedWith: [...item.sharedWith] })
8	
9	export function notesResolvers<Env>(implement: Implement<{ user: string }, Env>, undo: UndoStore, users: UserDirectory, notes: NoteStore) {
10	  const { notes: store, owners, added } = notes
11	  const keyOf = (session: { user: string }) => session.user.toLowerCase()
12	  const listOf = (session: { user: string } | null): Item[] => (session ? (store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []) : [])
13	  const ownListOf = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
14	    if (!session) return []
15	    const list = store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []
16	    store.set(keyOf(session), list)
17	    return list
18	  }
19	  // Times of the adds that went through, per user: at most ADD_LIMIT within ADD_WINDOW_MS.
20	  const ADD_LIMIT = 10
21	  const ADD_WINDOW_MS = 60_000
22	  const recentAdds = (session: { user: string }, now: number) => {
23	    const times = (added.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []).filter((at) => now - at < ADD_WINDOW_MS)
24	    added.set(keyOf(session), times)
25	    return times
26	  }
27	  const forget = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
28	    if (session) undo.delete(undoKeyOf(session))
29	  }
30	  return [
31	    implement(adminUsers, (_, { session, fail }) => {
32	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
33	      if (!isAdmin(session)) return fail('Forbidden', {})
34	      const keys = new Set([...users.keys(), ...[...store].filter(([, items]) => items.length > 0).map(([key]) => key)])
35	      return [...keys]
36	        .map((key) => ({ name: users.get(key) ?? owners.get(key) ?? key, notes: store.get(key)?.length ?? 0 }))
37	        .sort((a, b) => a.name.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.name.toLowerCase()))
38	    }),
39	    implement(noteDetail, ({ number }, { session, fail }) => {
40	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
41	      const n = Number(number)
42	      if (!Number.isInteger(n)) return fail('NotFound', {})
43	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.number === n)
44	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', {})
45	      return { ...view(item), archived: item.archived }
46	    }),
47	    implement(listNotes, (_, { session, fail }) =>
48	      session
49	        ? [...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && item.pinned), ...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && !item.pinned)].map(view)
50	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
51	    ),
52	    implement(exportNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
53	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', { message: 'Sign in' })
54	      const own = listOf(session)
55	      return {
56	        user: session.user,
57	        notes: [...own.filter((item) => item.pinned), ...own.filter((item) => !item.pinned)].map((item) => ({
58	          title: item.title,
59	          pinned: item.pinned,
60	          archived: item.archived,
61	          createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt).toISOString(),
62	        })),
63	      }
64	    }),
65	    implement(listArchived, (_, { session, fail }) =>
66	      session
67	        ? listOf(session).filter((item) => item.archived).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)).map(view)
68	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
69	    ),
70	    implement(sharedNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
71	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
72	      const me = keyOf(session)
73	      return [...store].flatMap(([owner, items]) =>
74	        owner === me
75	          ? []
76	          : items
77	              .filter((item) => !item.archived && item.sharedWith.some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === me))
78	              .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, title: item.title, owner: owners.get(owner) ?? owner })),
79	      )
80	    }),
81	    implement(shareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
82	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
83	      if (!session || !item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
84	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
85	      const clean = name.trim()
86	      if (clean.toLowerCase() === keyOf(session)) return fail('Self', {})
87	      owners.set(keyOf(session), session.user.trim())
88	      if (!item.sharedWith.some((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) item.sharedWith.push(clean)
89	      return view(item)
90	    }),
91	    implement(unshareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
92	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
93	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
94	      item.sharedWith = item.sharedWith.filter((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() !== name.trim().toLowerCase())
95	      return view(item)
96	    }),
97	    implement(archiveNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
98	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
99	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
100	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
101	      item.archived = true
102	      forget(session)
103	      return view(item)
104	    }),
105	    implement(restoreNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
106	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id && entry.archived)
107	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
108	      item.archived = false
109	      forget(session)
110	      return view(item)
111	    }),
112	    implement(addNote, ({ title }, { fail, session }) => {
113	      const items = ownListOf(session)
114	      if (!session) return fail('Invalid', { message: 'Signed out', fields: { title: 'Sign in first' } })
115	      const clean = title.trim()
116	      if (items.some((item) => item.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
117	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
118	      const now = Date.now()
119	      const times = recentAdds(session, now)
120	      if (times.length >= ADD_LIMIT) return fail('TooMany', {})
121	      times.push(now)
122	      const item = { id: notes.nextId(), title: clean, body: '', pinned: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), archived: false, sharedWith: [], number: nextNumber(notes, keyOf(session)) }
123	      items.unshift(item)
124	      forget(session)
125	      return view(item)
126	    }),
127	    implement(removeNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
128	      const items = ownListOf(session)
129	      const at = items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id)
130	      if (at < 0) return fail('NotFound', { id })
131	      if (items[at]?.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
132	      const [item] = items.splice(at, 1)
133	      if (session && item) undo.set(undoKeyOf(session), { item, at })
134	      return { id }
135	    }),
136	    implement(removeNotes, ({ ids }, { session }) => {
137	      const items = ownListOf(session)
138	      const removed = items.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived).map((item) => item.id)
139	      for (const id of removed) items.splice(items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id), 1)
140	      forget(session)
141	      return { ids: removed }
142	    }),
143	    implement(archiveNotes, ({ ids }, { session }) => {
144	      const archived = listOf(session).filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived)
145	      for (const item of archived) item.archived = true
146	      forget(session)
147	      return { ids: archived.map((item) => item.id) }
148	    }),
149	    implement(lastDeleted, (_, { session, fail }) => {
150	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
151	      const entry = undo.get(undoKeyOf(session))
152	      return entry ? { title: entry.item.title } : null
153	    }),
154	    implement(undoDelete, (_, { fail, session }) => {
155	      const entry = session ? undo.get(undoKeyOf(session)) : undefined
156	      if (!session || !entry) return fail('NothingToUndo', {})
157	      const items = ownListOf(session)
158	      items.splice(Math.min(entry.at, items.length), 0, entry.item)
159	      forget(session)
160	      return view(entry.item)
161	    }),
162	    implement(renameNote, ({ id, title }, { fail, session }) => {
163	      const items = listOf(session)
164	      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
165	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
166	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
167	      const clean = title.trim()
168	      if (items.some((entry) => entry.id !== id && entry.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
169	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
170	      item.title = clean
171	      forget(session)
172	      return view(item)
173	    }),
174	    implement(saveNote, ({ id, title, body }, { fail, session }) => {
175	      const items = listOf(session)
176	      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
177	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
178	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
179	      const clean = title.trim()
180	      if (items.some((entry) => entry.id !== id && entry.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
181	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
182	      item.title = clean
183	      item.body = body.trim()
184	      forget(session)
185	      return view(item)
186	    }),
187	    implement(togglePin, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
188	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
189	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
190	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
191	      item.pinned = !item.pinned
192	      forget(session)
193	      return view(item)
194	    }),
195	  ]
196	}

7	  owners: Map<string, string>
8	  // Times of the adds that went through, per user.
9	  added: Map<string, number[]>
10	  // Highest note number ever assigned to a user, so numbers are never reused.
11	  numbers: Map<string, number>
12	  nextId: () => string
13	}
14	
15	export function createNoteStore(): NoteStore {
16	  let seq = 0
17	  const nextId = () => `n${++seq}`
18	  // Entries are given newest first; numbers are assigned oldest first so the first entry ever added is No. 1.
19	  const seed = (notes: [string, string][]) =>
20	    notes.map(([title, createdAt], i) => ({
21	      id: nextId(),
22	      title,
23	      body: '',
24	      pinned: false,
25	      createdAt,
26	      archived: false,
27	      sharedWith: [] as string[],
28	      number: notes.length - i,
29	    }))
30	  const ada = seed([['Buy milk', '2026-01-15T09:00:00.000Z'], ['Call Bob', '2026-01-14T09:00:00.000Z']])
31	  const bob = seed([["Bob's secret", '2026-01-10T09:00:00.000Z']])
32	  return {
33	    notes: new Map<string, Item[]>([
34	      ['ada', ada],
35	      ['bob', bob],
36	    ]),
37	    owners: new Map(),
38	    added: new Map(),
39	    numbers: new Map([
40	      ['ada', ada.length],
41	      ['bob', bob.length],
42	    ]),
43	    nextId,
44	  }
45	}
46	
47	// The next note number for a user: one past the highest ever assigned to them, never reused.
48	export const nextNumber = (store: NoteStore, key: string) => {
49	  const n = (store.numbers.get(key) ?? 0) + 1
50	  store.numbers.set(key, n)
51	  return n
52	}
53	
54	// Drops everything kept for a user: their notes (archived and shared ones included), sharing, add history and numbering.
55	export const purgeUser = (store: NoteStore, key: string) => {
56	  store.notes.delete(key)
57	  store.owners.delete(key)
58	  store.added.delete(key)
59	  store.numbers.delete(key)
60	}

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { admin, archive, deleteAccount, home, notePage } from '../../routes.ts'
import {
  Add,
  adminUsers,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  lastDeleted,
  listArchived,
  noteDetail,
  noteNumberParam,
  Restore,
  Cancel,
  Edit,
  EditDraft,
  addedOn,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  listedNotes,
  hasMore,
  selectedCount,
  PAGE_SIZE,
  noMatch,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Save,
  SaveDetail,
  exportNotes,
  Search,
  Share,
  sharedNotes,
  Undo,
  Unshare,
  visibleNotes,
} from './model.ts'
import { text } from './text.ts'

const bulk = ui.formRef()

const errorText = part((code: string) =>
  code === 'duplicate' ? text.duplicate
    : code === 'notFound' ? text.notFound
    : code === 'archived' ? text.archived
    : code === 'tooMany' ? text.tooMany
    : code === 'nothingToUndo' ? text.nothingToUndo
    : code === 'selfShare' ? text.selfShare
    : code,
)

const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ search: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [text.notes]),
      ui.p({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [text.language]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.archivedNotes]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(deleteAccount, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.deleteAccount]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, [text.export]),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [text.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          minlength: 1,
          maxlength: 60,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50' }, [text.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded border bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                  ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, ['Deleted "', deleted.title, '"']),
                  ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, {}) } }, [
                    ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [text.undo]),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (all) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.count({ count: all.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', role: 'search', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                id: 'notes-search',
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': text.search,
                value: ctx.search,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [text.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              'Showing ',
              listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }).length,
              ' of ',
              selectedCount({ items: all, text: search.q }),
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, ['Selected: ', ctx.selected.length]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.archiveSelected]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.deleteSelected]),
            ]),
            noMatch({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search })
              ? ui.div({}, [
                  when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                  when(['idle', 'saving', 'removing', 'pinning', 'archiving', 'undoing', 'restoring', 'sharing', 'unsharing'], [
                    ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, [text.noMatch]),
                  ]),
                ])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                  ui.each(visibleNotes({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search }), 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.input({
                        type: 'checkbox',
                        form: bulk,
                        name: 'ids',
                        value: item.id,
                        'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                        checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),
                        disabled: ctx.busy,
                        on: { change: ui.send(Select, { id: item.id, checked: ui.dom.checked }) },
                      }),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['No. ', item.number]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'flex flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Save, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({
                              name: 'title',
                              'aria-label': 'Edit title',
                              required: true,
                              minlength: 1,
                              maxlength: 60,
                              value: ctx.editTitle,
                              'aria-invalid': ctx.editError !== null,
                              'aria-describedby': 'notes-edit-error',
                              class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1',
                              on: { input: ui.send(EditDraft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
                            }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.save]),
                            ui.p({ id: 'notes-edit-error', class: 'w-full text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.editError]),
                          ])
                        : ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, noteNumberParam({ number: item.number })), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Cancel, {}) } }, [
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.cancel]),
                          ])
                        : ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Edit, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'title', value: item.title }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.edit]),
                          ]),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [
                        'Added ',
                        ui.time({ datetime: item.createdAt }, [addedOn({ at: item.createdAt })]),
                      ]),
                      item.pinned && ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-amber-700' }, ['pinned']),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Pin, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [item.pinned ? text.unpin : text.pin]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Archive, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.archive]),
                      ]),
                      ui.each(item.sharedWith, null, (name) =>
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-600' }, [
                          ui.span({}, ['shared with ', name]),
                          ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Unshare, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'name', value: name }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, ['Unshare ', name]),
                          ]),
                        ]),
                      ),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Share, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.input({ name: 'name', 'aria-label': 'Share with', required: true, class: 'w-24 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-sm' }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.share]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Remove, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.delete]),
                      ]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
            hasMore({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }) &&
              ui.a(
                {
                  href: ui.link(home, null, { q: search.q, limit: search.limit + PAGE_SIZE }),
                  class: 'inline-block rounded border px-4 py-2 text-sm',
                },
                [text.loadMore],
              ),
          ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, [text.loading]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.signedOut]), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.unavailable]) },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        sharedNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (shared) =>
            shared.length === 0
              ? null
              : ui.section({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
                  ui.h2({ class: 'text-xl font-semibold' }, [text.sharedWithMe]),
                  ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                    ui.each(shared, 'id', (item) =>
                      ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [item.title]),
                        ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['from ', item.owner]),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const ArchiveBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: archive,
  render: ({ ctx }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Archive']),
      ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['All notes']),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        listArchived,
        {},
        {
          ready: (items) =>
            items.length === 0
              ? ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, ['No archived notes'])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  ui.each(items, 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, noteNumberParam({ number: item.number })), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Restore, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Restore']),
                      ]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…']),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Signed out']), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Unavailable']) },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const NoteDetailView = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: notePage,
  render: ({ ctx, params }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.query(
        noteDetail,
        { number: params.number },
        {
          ready: (note) =>
            ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
              ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [note.title]),
              ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, ['No. ', note.number]),
              ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
                'Added ',
                ui.time({ datetime: note.createdAt }, [addedOn({ at: note.createdAt })]),
              ]),
              note.pinned && ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-amber-700' }, [text.pinned]),
              note.archived && ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.noteArchived]),
              ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
              ctx.saved && ui.p({ role: 'status', class: 'text-emerald-700' }, [text.saved]),
              note.archived
                ? ui.p({ class: 'whitespace-pre-wrap' }, [note.body])
                : ui.form(
                    {
                      class: 'space-y-3',
                      on: {
                        submit: ui.send(SaveDetail, {
                          id: ui.dom.form('id'),
                          title: ui.dom.form('title'),
                          body: ui.dom.form('body'),
                        }),
                      },
                    },
                    [
                      ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: note.id }),
                      ui.label({ for: 'note-detail-title' }, [text.title]),
                      ui.input({
                        id: 'note-detail-title',
                        name: 'title',
                        required: true,
                        maxlength: 60,
                        value: ctx.detailTouched ? ctx.detailTitle : note.title,
                        'aria-invalid': ctx.detailTitleError !== null,
                        'aria-describedby': 'note-detail-title-error',
                        class: 'w-full rounded border px-3 py-2',
                      }),
                      ui.p({ id: 'note-detail-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [
                        ctx.detailTitleError !== null ? errorText(ctx.detailTitleError) : null,
                      ]),
                      ui.label({ for: 'note-detail-body' }, [text.body]),
                      ui.textarea({
                        id: 'note-detail-body',
                        name: 'body',
                        maxlength: 1000,
                        value: ctx.detailTouched ? ctx.detailBody : note.body,
                        'aria-invalid': ctx.detailBodyError !== null,
                        'aria-describedby': 'note-detail-body-error',
                        class: 'w-full rounded border px-3 py-2',
                      }),
                      ui.p({ id: 'note-detail-body-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [
                        ctx.detailBodyError !== null ? errorText(ctx.detailBodyError) : null,
                      ]),
                      ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white' }, [text.save]),
                    ],
                  ),
              ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.backToNotes]),
            ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, [text.loading]),
          failed: {
            Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.signedOut]),
            NotFound: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.noteNotFound]),
            Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.unavailable]),
          },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const AdminBoard = ui.view({
  route: admin,
  render: () =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.query(
        adminUsers,
        {},
        {
          ready: (rows) =>
            ui.div({ class: 'space-y-6' }, [
              ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Admin']),
              ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['All notes']),
              ui.table({ class: 'w-full rounded border bg-white text-left' }, [
                ui.thead({}, [
                  ui.tr({}, [ui.th({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, ['User']), ui.th({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, ['Notes'])]),
                ]),
                ui.tbody({}, [
                  ui.each(rows, 'name', (row) =>
                    ui.tr({ class: 'border-t' }, [ui.td({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, [row.name]), ui.td({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, [row.notes])]),
                  ),
                ]),
              ]),
            ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…']),
          failed: {
            Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Signed out']),
            Forbidden: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Not allowed']),
            Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Unavailable']),
          },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const selectsNote = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [{ send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: true } }],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: ['n1'] } },
})

export const unselectsNote = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: true } },
    { send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: false } },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: [] } },
})

export const deletesSelected = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: Bulk, payload: { ids: ['n1', 'n2'], action: 'delete' } },
    { done: removeNotes, result: { ids: ['n1', 'n2'] } },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: [], busy: false }, effects: [{ effect: removeNotes, input: { ids: ['n1', 'n2'] } }] },
})

export const archivesSelected = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: Bulk, payload: { ids: ['n1'], action: 'archive' } },
    { done: archiveNotes, result: { ids: ['n1'] } },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: [], busy: false }, effects: [{ effect: archiveNotes, input: { ids: ['n1'] } }] },
})

export const ignoresEmptySelection = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [{ send: Bulk, payload: { ids: [], action: 'delete' } }],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: {}, effects: [] },
})

1	import { project, ui } from '@hozu/core'
2	import { zodAdapter } from '@hozu/schema-zod'

# Forms

- **Works without JavaScript** when the submit payload reads only `ui.dom.form('name')`, `ui.dom.formAll('name')`,
  literals, context, params and search (else HZ036 warns). Put every value the submit needs in a named field.
```ts
ui.form({ on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title'), kind: ui.dom.form('kind') }) } }, [
  ui.label({ for: 'title' }, ['Title']),
  ui.input({ id: 'title', name: 'title', required: true, minlength: 2, value: ctx.draft,
    'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null, 'aria-describedby': 'title-error',
    on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { text: ui.dom.value }) } }),
  ui.select({ name: 'kind', 'aria-label': 'Kind' }, kinds.map((k) => ui.option({ value: k, selected: ctx.kind === k }, [k]))),
  ui.button({ type: 'submit' }, ['Add']),
])
ui.p({ id: 'title-error', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title])
```
- **Field errors:** context `fields: z.object({ title: z.string().nullable() })`, reset on submit
  (`ctx.fields = { title: null }`), and `failed.Invalid: { target: 'idle', assign: (e) => { ctx.fields = e.fields } }`.
  Limits live in the mutation's input schema (`z.string().min(2, '…')`), never in the event payload (HZ061).
- **Server error:** a declared error sets `ctx.error`; show `ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [ctx.error])`.
- **Enum from a select:** fills an enum field only when every literal option value is a member (HZ033).

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs forms --more

# Forms

- **Works without JavaScript** when the submit payload reads only `ui.dom.form('name')`, `ui.dom.formAll('name')`,
  literals, context, params and search (else HZ036 warns). Put every value the submit needs in a named field.
```ts

  ui.label({ for: 'title' }, ['Title']),
  ui.input({ id: 'title', name: 'title', required: true, minlength: 2, value: ctx.draft,
    'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null, 'aria-describedby': 'title-error',
    on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { text: ui.dom.value }) } }),
  ui.select({ name: 'kind', 'aria-label': 'Kind' }, kinds.map((k) => ui.option({ value: k, selected: ctx.kind === k }, [k]))),
  ui.button({ type: 'submit' }, ['Add']),
])
ui.p({ id: 'title-error', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title])
```
- **Field errors:** context `fields: z.object({ title: z.string().nullable() })`, reset on submit
  (`ctx.fields = { title: null }`), and `failed.Invalid: { target: 'idle', assign: (e) => { ctx.fields = e.fields } }`.
  Limits live in the mutation's input schema (`z.string().min(2, '…')`), never in the event payload (HZ061).
- **Server error:** a declared error sets `ctx.error`; show `ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [ctx.error])`.
- **Enum from a select:** fills an enum field only when every literal option value is a member (HZ033).

- **Without JavaScript,** the server runs the same machine for a native post, then redirects or re-renders with the
  result (e.g. a `<select name="kind">` carries the kind).
- **With the app's kit** (as in `example/`): a `Field` with a `control` slot holds the label, the input and its error.
```ts
ui.use(Field, { props: { for: 'title', label: 'Title', error: ctx.fields.title, errorId: 'title-error' },
  slots: { control: ui.use(Input, { props: { id: 'title', name: 'title', value: ctx.draft, required: true,
    invalid: ctx.fields.title !== null, describedby: 'title-error' }, on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { text: ui.dom.value }) } }) } }),
ui.use(Button, { props: { type: 'submit' } }, ['Add']),
```
- **Limit messages:** `z.string().min(2, 'Use at least 2 characters')`.
- **Clear after success:** bind `value: ctx.draft` and reset it in `done`.
- **Per-item actions without JS:** wrap each button in its own small form.
- **Enum source:** `ui.dom.form('kind')` or `ui.dom.value`.
- **Several values:** `ui.dom.formAll('ids')` is every value of the name in tree order (`[]` when none) for checkbox
  groups, `select multiple` and controls inside `ui.each`, into a list field; `ui.dom.form(name)` is the first (HZ054).
- **Which button:** give submit buttons `name` and a literal `value` and read `ui.dom.form('action')` in the form's
  submit; JS and no-JS read the same value. Into an enum only when every submit button of the form has that name and
  a member value, else make the field nullable (HZ033). No `on.click` on a submit button (HZ056).
- **Controls outside the form** (forms cannot nest): `const bulk = ui.formRef()` at module level,
  `ui.form({ ref: bulk, … })`, `ui.input({ form: bulk, … })`; a string `form` is HZ014, a name no control has HZ055.
- **A flag or a number:** a checkbox posts `'on'` only while checked: `ui.dom.formAll('remember')` into
  `z.array(z.string())`, or a radio pair. Send numbers as text and parse them in the mutation input (`z.coerce.number()`).
- **Invalid without JS:** a native post whose payload or mutation input fails re-renders with 400 through
  `failed.Invalid`, like the JS submit.

content.content:
# Views

```ts
export const Board = ui.view({
  machine: m,        // optional: without it, no ctx / when / events, and 0 JS
  route: home,       // optional: render gets { params, search } typed by the route
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ q: search.q }),   // optional, with machine + route: context fields from the URL
  render: ({ ctx, when, params, search, locale }) => ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl' }, [ /* children */ ]),
})
```
- **Elements:** `ui.<tag>(attrs, children)` for every HTML and SVG element; void tags (`input`, `img`) take only attrs.
  Children are nodes, strings, numbers, data values, and `null` / `false` (render nothing).
- **Classes:** `class` is a static string of Tailwind classes that must exist (HZ026); conditional classes:
  `toggle: { 'bg-indigo-600 text-white': ctx.tab === t }`. No `style`.
- **Conditions:** `ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [ctx.error])`, `item.done ? 'done' : 'open'`.
  By machine state: `when(['adding', 'saving'], [ui.p({}, ['Saving…'])])`.
- **Lists:** `ui.each(items, 'id', (item) => ui.li({}, [item.title]))`. Never `.map` over data.
- **Events:** `on: { click: ui.send(Event, payload) }`; payload fields are literals, data, `ui.dom.value`,
  `ui.dom.form('name')` (submit; `hozu docs forms`).
- **Links:** `ui.a({ href: ui.link(itemPage, { id: item.id }) }, [...])`; never a string path (HZ032).
- **Data:** `ui.query(listItems, input, { ready: (items) => …, failed: { NotFound: () => …, Unexpected: () => … } })`;
  `failed` lists every declared error plus `Unexpected`.
- **Shared UI** (buttons, inputs, fields): `ui.use(Button, { variant, props, on }, ['Save'])` of a kit component
  (`hozu docs components`).

- **Attributes:** HTML names in lower case (`for`, `minlength`, `aria-pressed`, `data-x`), typed per tag. Values are

content.content:
1	import type { Implement } from '@hozu/data'
2	import { adminUsers, addNote, exportNotes, archiveNote, archiveNotes, removeNotes, lastDeleted, listArchived, listNotes, noteDetail, removeNote, renameNote, restoreNote, saveNote, setAccountAccess, shareNote, sharedNotes, togglePin, undoDelete, unshareNote } from './model.ts'
3	import { type Item, type UndoStore, undoKeyOf } from './undo.ts'
4	import { ADMIN, type UserDirectory, isAdmin, isReadOnly } from '../account/users.ts'
5	import { nextNumber, type NoteStore } from './store.ts'
6	
7	const view = ({ archived: _, ...item }: Item) => ({ ...item, sharedWith: [...item.sharedWith] })
8	
9	export function notesResolvers<Env>(implement: Implement<{ user: string }, Env>, undo: UndoStore, users: UserDirectory, notes: NoteStore) {
10	  const { notes: store, owners, added } = notes
11	  const keyOf = (session: { user: string }) => session.user.toLowerCase()
12	  const listOf = (session: { user: string } | null): Item[] => (session ? (store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []) : [])
13	  const ownListOf = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
14	    if (!session) return []
15	    const list = store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []
16	    store.set(keyOf(session), list)
17	    return list
18	  }
19	  // Times of the adds that went through, per user: at most ADD_LIMIT within ADD_WINDOW_MS.
20	  const ADD_LIMIT = 10
21	  const ADD_WINDOW_MS = 60_000
22	  const recentAdds = (session: { user: string }, now: number) => {
23	    const times = (added.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []).filter((at) => now - at < ADD_WINDOW_MS)
24	    added.set(keyOf(session), times)
25	    return times
26	  }
27	  const forget = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
28	    if (session) undo.delete(undoKeyOf(session))
29	  }
30	  return [
31	    implement(adminUsers, (_, { session, fail }) => {
32	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
33	      if (!isAdmin(session)) return fail('Forbidden', {})
34	      const keys = new Set([...users.keys(), ...[...store].filter(([, items]) => items.length > 0).map(([key]) => key)])
35	      return [...keys]
36	        .map((key) => ({
37	          name: users.get(key)?.name ?? owners.get(key) ?? key,
38	          notes: store.get(key)?.length ?? 0,
39	          readOnly: key === ADMIN ? false : (users.get(key)?.readOnly ?? false),
40	        }))
41	        .sort((a, b) => a.name.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.name.toLowerCase()))
42	    }),
43	    implement(setAccountAccess, ({ name, access }, { session, fail }) => {
44	      if (!session || !isAdmin(session)) return fail('Forbidden', {})
45	      const key = name.trim().toLowerCase()
46	      if (key === ADMIN) return fail('Forbidden', {})
47	      const existing = users.get(key)
48	      users.set(key, { name: existing?.name ?? name.trim(), readOnly: access === 'readOnly' })
49	      return {}
50	    }),
51	    implement(noteDetail, ({ number }, { session, fail }) => {
52	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
53	      const n = Number(number)
54	      if (!Number.isInteger(n)) return fail('NotFound', {})
55	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.number === n)
56	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', {})
57	      return { ...view(item), archived: item.archived }
58	    }),
59	    implement(listNotes, (_, { session, fail }) =>
60	      session
61	        ? [...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && item.pinned), ...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && !item.pinned)].map(view)
62	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
63	    ),
64	    implement(exportNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
65	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', { message: 'Sign in' })
66	      const own = listOf(session)
67	      return {
68	        user: session.user,
69	        notes: [...own.filter((item) => item.pinned), ...own.filter((item) => !item.pinned)].map((item) => ({
70	          title: item.title,
71	          pinned: item.pinned,
72	          archived: item.archived,
73	          createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt).toISOString(),
74	        })),
75	      }
76	    }),
77	    implement(listArchived, (_, { session, fail }) =>
78	      session
79	        ? listOf(session).filter((item) => item.archived).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)).map(view)
80	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
81	    ),
82	    implement(sharedNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
83	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
84	      const me = keyOf(session)
85	      return [...store].flatMap(([owner, items]) =>
86	        owner === me
87	          ? []
88	          : items
89	              .filter((item) => !item.archived && item.sharedWith.some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === me))
90	              .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, title: item.title, owner: owners.get(owner) ?? owner })),
91	      )
92	    }),
93	    implement(shareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
94	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
95	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
96	      if (!session || !item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
97	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
98	      const clean = name.trim()
99	      if (clean.toLowerCase() === keyOf(session)) return fail('Self', {})
100	      owners.set(keyOf(session), session.user.trim())
101	      if (!item.sharedWith.some((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) item.sharedWith.push(clean)
102	      return view(item)
103	    }),
104	    implement(unshareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
105	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
106	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
107	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
108	      item.sharedWith = item.sharedWith.filter((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() !== name.trim().toLowerCase())
109	      return view(item)
110	    }),
111	    implement(archiveNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
112	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
113	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
114	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
115	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
116	      item.archived = true
117	      forget(session)
118	      return view(item)
119	    }),
120	    implement(restoreNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
121	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
122	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id && entry.archived)
123	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
124	      item.archived = false
125	      forget(session)
126	      return view(item)
127	    }),
128	    implement(addNote, ({ title }, { fail, session }) => {
129	      const items = ownListOf(session)
130	      if (!session) return fail('Invalid', { message: 'Signed out', fields: { title: 'Sign in first' } })
131	      if (isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
132	      const clean = title.trim()
133	      if (items.some((item) => item.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
134	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
135	      const now = Date.now()
136	      const times = recentAdds(session, now)
137	      if (times.length >= ADD_LIMIT) return fail('TooMany', {})
138	      times.push(now)
139	      const item = { id: notes.nextId(), title: clean, body: '', pinned: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), archived: false, sharedWith: [], number: nextNumber(notes, keyOf(session)) }
140	      items.unshift(item)
141	      forget(session)
142	      return view(item)
143	    }),
144	    implement(removeNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
145	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
146	      const items = ownListOf(session)
147	      const at = items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id)
148	      if (at < 0) return fail('NotFound', { id })
149	      if (items[at]?.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
150	      const [item] = items.splice(at, 1)
151	      if (session && item) undo.set(undoKeyOf(session), { item, at })
152	      return { id }
153	    }),
154	    implement(removeNotes, ({ ids }, { session, fail }) => {
155	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
156	      const items = ownListOf(session)
157	      const removed = items.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived).map((item) => item.id)
158	      for (const id of removed) items.splice(items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id), 1)
159	      forget(session)
160	      return { ids: removed }
161	    }),
162	    implement(archiveNotes, ({ ids }, { session, fail }) => {
163	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
164	      const archived = listOf(session).filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived)
165	      for (const item of archived) item.archived = true
166	      forget(session)
167	      return { ids: archived.map((item) => item.id) }
168	    }),
169	    implement(lastDeleted, (_, { session, fail }) => {
170	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
171	      const entry = undo.get(undoKeyOf(session))
172	      return entry ? { title: entry.item.title } : null
173	    }),
174	    implement(undoDelete, (_, { fail, session }) => {
175	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
176	      const entry = session ? undo.get(undoKeyOf(session)) : undefined
177	      if (!session || !entry) return fail('NothingToUndo', {})
178	      const items = ownListOf(session)
179	      items.splice(Math.min(entry.at, items.length), 0, entry.item)
180	      forget(session)
181	      return view(entry.item)
182	    }),
183	    implement(renameNote, ({ id, title }, { fail, session }) => {
184	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
185	      const items = listOf(session)
186	      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
187	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
188	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
189	      const clean = title.trim()
190	      if (items.some((entry) => entry.id !== id && entry.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
191	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
192	      item.title = clean
193	      forget(session)
194	      return view(item)
195	    }),
196	    implement(saveNote, ({ id, title, body }, { fail, session }) => {
197	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
198	      const items = listOf(session)
199	      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
200	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
201	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
202	      const clean = title.trim()
203	      if (items.some((entry) => entry.id !== id && entry.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
204	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
205	      item.title = clean
206	      item.body = body.trim()
207	      forget(session)
208	      return view(item)
209	    }),
210	    implement(togglePin, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
211	      if (session && isReadOnly(users, session)) return fail('ReadOnly', {})
212	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
213	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
214	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
215	      item.pinned = !item.pinned
216	      forget(session)
217	      return view(item)
218	    }),
219	  ]
220	}

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { admin, archive, deleteAccount, home, notePage } from '../../routes.ts'
import {
  Add,
  adminUsers,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  lastDeleted,
  listArchived,
  noteDetail,
  noteNumberParam,
  Restore,
  Cancel,
  Edit,
  EditDraft,
  addedOn,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  listedNotes,
  hasMore,
  selectedCount,
  PAGE_SIZE,
  noMatch,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Save,
  SaveDetail,
  exportNotes,
  Search,
  Share,
  sharedNotes,
  Undo,
  Unshare,
  visibleNotes,
} from './model.ts'
import { text } from './text.ts'

const bulk = ui.formRef()

const errorText = part((code: string) =>
  code === 'duplicate' ? text.duplicate
    : code === 'notFound' ? text.notFound
    : code === 'archived' ? text.archived
    : code === 'tooMany' ? text.tooMany
    : code === 'nothingToUndo' ? text.nothingToUndo
    : code === 'selfShare' ? text.selfShare
    : code,
)

const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ search: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [text.notes]),
      ui.p({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [text.language]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.archivedNotes]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(deleteAccount, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.deleteAccount]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, [text.export]),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [text.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          minlength: 1,
          maxlength: 60,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50' }, [text.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded border bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                  ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, ['Deleted "', deleted.title, '"']),
                  ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, {}) } }, [
                    ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [text.undo]),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (all) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.count({ count: all.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', role: 'search', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                id: 'notes-search',
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': text.search,
                value: ctx.search,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [text.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              'Showing ',
              listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }).length,
              ' of ',
              selectedCount({ items: all, text: search.q }),
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, ['Selected: ', ctx.selected.length]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.archiveSelected]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.deleteSelected]),
            ]),
            noMatch({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search })
              ? ui.div({}, [
                  when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                  when(['idle', 'saving', 'removing', 'pinning', 'archiving', 'undoing', 'restoring', 'sharing', 'unsharing'], [
                    ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, [text.noMatch]),
                  ]),
                ])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                  ui.each(visibleNotes({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search }), 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.input({
                        type: 'checkbox',
                        form: bulk,
                        name: 'ids',
                        value: item.id,
                        'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                        checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),
                        disabled: ctx.busy,
                        on: { change: ui.send(Select, { id: item.id, checked: ui.dom.checked }) },
                      }),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['No. ', item.number]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'flex flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Save, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({
                              name: 'title',
                              'aria-label': 'Edit title',
                              required: true,
                              minlength: 1,
                              maxlength: 60,
                              value: ctx.editTitle,
                              'aria-invalid': ctx.editError !== null,
                              'aria-describedby': 'notes-edit-error',
                              class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1',
                              on: { input: ui.send(EditDraft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
                            }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.save]),
                            ui.p({ id: 'notes-edit-error', class: 'w-full text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.editError]),
                          ])
                        : ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, noteNumberParam({ number: item.number })), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Cancel, {}) } }, [
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.cancel]),
                          ])
                        : ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Edit, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'title', value: item.title }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.edit]),
                          ]),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [
                        'Added ',
                        ui.time({ datetime: item.createdAt }, [addedOn({ at: item.createdAt })]),
                      ]),
                      item.pinned && ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-amber-700' }, ['pinned']),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Pin, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [item.pinned ? text.unpin : text.pin]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Archive, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.archive]),
                      ]),
                      ui.each(item.sharedWith, null, (name) =>
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-600' }, [
                          ui.span({}, ['shared with ', name]),
                          ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Unshare, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'name', value: name }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, ['Unshare ', name]),
                          ]),
                        ]),
                      ),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Share, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.input({ name: 'name', 'aria-label': 'Share with', required: true, class: 'w-24 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-sm' }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.share]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Remove, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.delete]),
                      ]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
            hasMore({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }) &&
              ui.a(
                {
                  href: ui.link(home, null, { q: search.q, limit: search.limit + PAGE_SIZE }),
                  class: 'inline-block rounded border px-4 py-2 text-sm',
                },
                [text.loadMore],
              ),
          ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, [text.loading]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.signedOut]), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.unavailable]) },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        sharedNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (shared) =>
            shared.length === 0
              ? null
              : ui.section({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
                  ui.h2({ class: 'text-xl font-semibold' }, [text.sharedWithMe]),
                  ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                    ui.each(shared, 'id', (item) =>
                      ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [item.title]),
                        ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['from ', item.owner]),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const ArchiveBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: archive,
  render: ({ ctx }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Archive']),
      ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['All notes']),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        listArchived,
        {},
        {
          ready: (items) =>
            items.length === 0
              ? ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, ['No archived notes'])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  ui.each(items, 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, noteNumberParam({ number: item.number })), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
